Fx.title: Foreign exchange
Fx.body:
Foreign exchange maintains the rate register and the period-end revaluation. A rate is always recorded as a new dated row, never edited.

The revaluation computes the unrealised gain or loss on open positions at the closing rate, shows it as a preview first and posts only after your confirmation.

Foreign amounts print in their own currency, book values in the workspace base currency.
